input.quote: 15.11 Limitation of Liability. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW AND NOTWITHSTANDING ANY PROVISION IN THIS AGREEMENT TO THE CONTRARY, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL, RELIANCE OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES OR LOST OR IMPUTED PROFITS OR ROYALTIES OR COST OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES
input.rationale: Section 15.11 is the only limitation-of-liability provision; the arbitration clause (p0830) adds a mutual waiver of consequential/punitive damages but no cap. Both provisions are mutual as to indirect and consequential damages, but neither imposes any aggregate monetary cap, and no cap or carve-out language sits in the indemnification (Article 12) or insurance provisions. PB's direct liability is therefore entirely uncapped, which fails the fallback (mutual cap of 12 months' fees with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct). We proposed the shortest fallback cure: one added sentence pair in Section 15.11 creating a mutual twelve-months'-fees cap with Excluded Claims outside it. The existing carve-out preserving PB's payment obligations under Article 6 and Section 14.2 is retained and is consistent with the new cap.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-months'-fees aggregate liability cap to Section 15.11, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct carved out.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 excludes consequential damages but leaves each Party's direct liability entirely uncapped, so we added our fallback position: a mutual cap at twelve months' fees, with indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct sitting outside the cap.

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations, breach of its confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
